name: Kreebi SEO
author: Bipin Khatri

sections.description:
Kreebi SEO puts every SEO setting of your site in one place. Open Kreebi SEO in wp-admin: your site’s icon, logo and default social image are at the top, and every page, post and category is listed below. Click one to set how it looks in search results and when it’s shared.

Site-wide

  • Site title, tagline and Site Icon (favicon): the same WordPress settings as in Settings and the Customizer, editable here too.
  • Logo for search engines: the organization (or person) logo search engines show for your site.
  • Default social image: used when a page has no image of its own and no featured image.
  • Title patterns: choose a separator and how titles are built for the home page, pages and posts, archives, search results and 404 pages.
  • Social profiles and X (Twitter) username.
  • Verification codes for Google Search Console, Bing, Yandex, Baidu and Pinterest.

For every page, post, product and category

  • SEO title and meta description, with a live search-result preview and character counters.
  • Social title, description and image (Open Graph and X/Twitter cards).
  • Canonical URL.
  • Hide from search engines (noindex) and nofollow.

Indexing

  • XML sitemap: builds on WordPress’s own sitemap. Hidden pages are left out, last-modified dates are added, and you can leave out post types, taxonomies and author pages.
  • robots.txt: keep the WordPress default or write your own.
  • llms.txt: a plain-text map of your site for AI assistants, built automatically from your site name, tagline and each page’s title, address and description, or written by hand.
  • Schema.org (JSON-LD): organization or person, website, web page and article data.

Works with other SEO plugins

Running two SEO plugins gives pages two titles, two descriptions and two sets of social tags. When Kreebi SEO finds Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, Slim SEO or Squirrly SEO active, it pauses its own output and tells you, with a button to deactivate the other plugin. Your Kreebi SEO settings are kept and go live once only one SEO plugin is active.

Privacy

Kreebi SEO does not contact any external service, does not track you or your visitors and does not set cookies. Everything stays in your WordPress database.

For developers

Other plugins can read and change Kreebi SEO’s data with these functions:

  • kreseo_get_post_seo( $post_id ) / kreseo_update_post_seo( $post_id, $data, $source )
  • kreseo_get_term_seo( $term_id ) / kreseo_update_term_seo( $term_id, $data, $source )
  • kreseo_get_settings() / kreseo_update_settings( $data, $source )
  • kreseo_get_site_identity() / kreseo_update_site_identity( $data, $source )
  • kreseo_get_llms_txt()
  • kreseo_output_active(): false while Kreebi SEO is paused because another SEO plugin is active

Each change fires an action (kreseo_post_seo_updated, kreseo_term_seo_updated, kreseo_settings_updated, kreseo_site_identity_updated) with the old and new values and who made the change. Filters: kreseo_context, kreseo_schema_graph, kreseo_llms_txt, kreseo_conflicting_plugins, kreseo_output_paused.
sections.installation:
1. Install Kreebi SEO from Plugins › Add New, or upload the kreebi-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Open Kreebi SEO in the admin menu.
sections.faq:
Why don’t my SEO titles show?

Your theme has to let WordPress write the page title (“title-tag” support). Almost all themes do; Kreebi SEO warns you if yours doesn’t.

My robots.txt or llms.txt changes don’t show.

If a real robots.txt or llms.txt file exists in your site’s folder, the server sends that file and WordPress never sees the request. Delete the file through your host or FTP. Kreebi SEO never writes files. llms.txt at /llms.txt also needs pretty permalinks (Settings › Permalinks); without them it’s at /?kreseo_llms=1.

Does it add meta keywords?

No. Google and Bing don’t use them.

What happens to my settings if I uninstall it?

They stay in your database, so they’re back if you install Kreebi SEO again.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: redesigned Settings: clear sections, on/off switches, the title variables at a glance and a Save bar that stays in view.
  • Privacy: the users sitemap is always off, so usernames are never listed. The “Include author pages” setting is removed.
  • WordPress’s sample content (the “Hello world!” post, the “Sample Page”, and “Uncategorized” while it holds only that post) is left out of the sitemap and llms.txt and is noindex.
  • llms.txt is rebuilt right after an update.
  • New: a Kreebi AI Builder section on the main screen, shown when the builder isn’t installed or fully set up.
  • The Kreebi SEO menu item now sits together with Kreebi AI and Kreebi Forms, just above Appearance.

1.0.0

  • First release.

short_description: Simple, fast SEO from one screen: titles, meta descriptions, social images, canonical URLs, noindex, sitemaps, robots.txt, llms.txt and schema.
